0.1.516: Grasping Mail now rolls Ring Modifiers (All Elemental Resistances, Rarity of Items found and more) and accepts Catalysts (separate from base quality; pick it under "Catalyst" in the quality bar)
Fixed some tiers of mods (maximum Life, resistances, Rarity of Items found…) having a 0% chance on Strength/Dexterity/Intelligence Helmets, Gloves, Boots, Body Armours and on Talismans
0.1.515: "Target next move": Omens that don't change the result (e.g. Omen of Dextral Necromancy when prefixes are full) are no longer listed. Fixed the numbers drifting between with and without the Omen
"Target next move": the ▾ on each row shows how that number was counted
"Target next move": Chaos Orb is now a candidate too (Chaos spam: a hit if the targets line up, even if current mods are removed)
Greater / Perfect currency cards now show "Only mod level ◯+ tiers" at the top
Fixed the Abyssal Echoes reroll button sometimes missing after 50+ steps
Fixed shared recipes over 50 steps losing their first steps (replays didn't recreate the same item)
0.1.514: Base picker: "Show more" scrolls so "Collapse" stays visible, and collapsing returns to where you were (also fixed short scrolling on wide screens)
0.1.513: Added a hint (?) next to "Search these mods on trade" explaining how the search is built
0.1.512: Fixed duplicated rows when the same mod appears twice (e.g. a fluxed resistance and a fractured resistance)
Removed the "Aldur" tag shown on fluxed mods
Added "Include base" next to "Search these mods on trade" (off by default: searches mods only, without base, Item Level or sockets)
Feedback can now include up to 3 images (paste works too)
